name: Pierre-Patrick Tswa-wen
title: Founder
bio: Pierre-Patrick Tswa-wen (PP) is the founder and CEO of Kolm Shield, a Cape Town deep-tech company building post-quantum security for critical digital infrastructure. Born and raised in Kingasani, a township of Kinshasa, DR Congo, PP trained as a control systems engineer, specialising in power system stability: catching the small oscillations that, left unchecked, cause a system to collapse. That habit of spotting problems before they destabilise an entire network led him to found Kolm Shield and its patent-pending technology. He lives by a motto adapted from his late father: “In everything you do, always aim for excellence and impact.”
